executive_summary: Maven build failed due to 45 compilation errors caused by missing dependencies. The project requires Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies that are not declared in pom.xml. All errors are dependency-related and can be resolved by adding the missing dependencies to the project configuration.

errors.message: Spring Security packages not found (web.builders, web.configuration, config.http, security.web)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class attempts to use Spring Security annotations and classes but the required dependency is not declared.

errors.message: Spring Data JPA packages not found (data.domain, data.jpa.repository, repository.query)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository and use Spring Data annotations but the required dependency is not declared.

Jakarta Persistence API dependency is missing. Entity classes use JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) but jakarta.persistence package cannot be found. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml (includes Jakarta Persistence API). If already added, verify Spring Boot version compatibility.

errors.message: Apache Commons Lang3 package not found
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils class attempts to import from org.apache.commons.lang3 but the dependency is not declared.

summary: 4 grouped dependency errors found affecting 45 compilation failures
